summary: Representative-browser smoke could not be completed because the verifier refused the public GitHub Pages URL before load. Exact published gh-pages bytes were inspected instead: they contain the candidate/no-current marker, textarea maxlength=1800, six voice choices, an initially disabled generate/load button, input/change handlers that only update local UI state, and the only POST-generating path behind the explicit generate button click. This static evidence does not substitute for render/network observation, so no live browser smoke or Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is claimed.
tests: Public candidate browser open attempted; verifier returned 'URL ... is not accessible via this tool' before page load.
Static published source: marker='candidate · no current'.
Static published source: textarea maxlength=1800 and counter initialized '0 / 1800'.
Static published source: exactly six select options — Martín, Lucía, Inés, Bruno, Vera, Milo.
Static published source: generate/load button starts disabled; update() enables only when text length >0 and <=1800 and not busy.
Static published source: text input and voice change handlers contain no fetch; POST exists only in generate(), reached from go.addEventListener('click', run).
Generate button clicks performed: 0; POST requests intentionally performed: 0.
unresolved: A representative JavaScript browser with network observation must load the public candidate to verify actual render, input/voice interaction, 1800-limit behavior and zero POST on load/change.

spawn_candidates.reason: This job's mission requires a representative interactive browser, but the compact frontier advertised required_capabilities=[]; the current verifier therefore won a job it cannot dynamically execute.
acceptance: Browser-smoke candidate exposes representative_javascript_browser and browser_network_navigation_to_github_pages as required capabilities before claim.
A worker lacking either capability skips preclaim without owning the browser-smoke job.
